title: IVG Savr 3000 Blue Razz Cherry Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Blue Razz Cherry IVG Savr 3000 Prefilled Pods pair sweet-tart Blue Raspberry with the rich fruitiness of Cherry. This combination delivers bold, bright flavour in every puff. Each pack includes a 2ml pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, plus a 4ml refill reservoir that fits securely to form an auto-refilling system. Designed for the IVG Savr 3000 Kit, it ensures long-lasting flavour with minimal fuss. How to Set Up IVG Savr Prefilled Pod's Step 1: Unpack the Device Remove the cap from the mouthpiece. Take out the silicone stopper from the pod. Step 2: Prepare the Refill Peel off the red sticker. Remove the rubber stop. Step 3: Connect the Pod Align the refill with the pod. Press until you hear a click. Step 4: Insert into Device Slide the full pod-and-refill unit into the Savr device. Step 5: Prime the Coil Wait a few minutes to let the coil fully saturate. ✅ Ready to Vape! Inhale to activate and enjoy.
